title: Among exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') in California that opened
question: Among exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') in California that opened in or after 2005 and have at least 30 test takers, identify the top 5 ranked by their eligible free or reduced price meal rate for grades K–12. Return the school name, city, county, number of test takers, average SAT writing score, and the calculated FRPM rate.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  s."XCL_047" AS school_name,
  s."XCL_050" AS city,
  s."XCL_045" AS county,
  sat."XCL_036" AS num_test_takers,
  sat."XCL_039" AS avg_sat_writing,
  CAST(f."XCL_020" + f."XCL_022" AS REAL) / f."XCL_019" AS frpm_rate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s."XCL_041" = f."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN satscores AS sat ON s."XCL_041" = sat."XCL_030"
WHERE s."XCL_076" = 'F'
  AND s."XCL_061" >= '2005-01-01'
  AND sat."XCL_036" >= 30
  AND f."XCL_019" > 0
ORDER BY frpm_rate DESC
LIMIT 5
